tone_statements.citation: Pan, Lina 潘丽娜. 2018. 云南石林下冒水洞村阿细彝语音系研究 [A study of the sound system of Axi Yi of Xiamaoshuidong village, Shilin]. MA thesis, 中南民族大学 (South-Central Minzu University). 204 pp.
tone_statements.quote: It analyzes consonants,vowels,tones and syllables in the A'Xi dialect and sums up their respective characteristics.The consonant system of Yunnan Shilin is relatively developed.There is a total of 46 consonants,including 5 initial consonants.In terms of vowels,it has 18 monophthongs,which involves vowel elastic opposition,but it is not one-to-one,diphthong as main vowels appears in Chinese loanwords,but rarely in the dialect system itself;In terms of tones,the A'Xi dialect has 3 tones: medium flat tone 44,low flat tone 22 and low falling tone 21.
tone_statements.locator: author's English abstract on the CNKI record page (thesis TOC: 第三章 语音系统, 第三节 声调); thesis pages not seen

tone.says: Ch. 3 sec. 3 声调 is a dedicated tone section (TOC seen). Abstract: three tones - mid level 44, low level 22, low falling 21; 46 initials, 18 monophthongs with a tense/lax ('elastic') vowel opposition that is not one-to-one; syllable chapter follows. Only the abstract and TOC were readable; the tone chapter itself (sandhi, tone-phonation co-occurrence, any acoustic data) was not opened.
